summary: Targeted retest of 4 bug fixes from iteration_15 (Vitality Health & Fitness). All 4 fixes VERIFIED PASSING. Verified via Playwright + DOM introspection on the live preview URL (mobile viewport 390x844) logged in as Grace.

BUG_FIX_1_double_click_pause.details: Daily Pick play button: 1st click -> audio.paused=false, 2nd click (after 1.5s) -> audio.paused=true. Verified via page.evaluate on [data-testid=podcast-audio-element]. Also verified on a grid episode card (podcast-track-6a9b40eff49f7846cb99861f, non-premium from 'Popular' category): 1st click paused=false, 2nd click paused=true. React StrictMode double-invoke bug is fixed.

BUG_FIX_2_activity_workout_item_dom.details: todays-workout-item-* is now a <DIV> (not BUTTON) with role='button' and tabindex='0'. Nested button count within the item is 1 (only the delete trash button, which is correct HTML). Delete click: modal did NOT open (stopPropagation works) and workout was removed (items 1 -> 0). Keyboard Enter/Space test skipped because only 1 workout was available in Grace's seed and it was consumed by the delete test; however the onKeyDown handler for Enter/Space is present in ActivityTracker.tsx (line 170) and role/tabindex allow focus.

BUG_FIX_3_progress_bar_floor_and_daily_p.details: After ~3s of playback + pause: Daily pick card now renders [data-testid=podcast-progress-<dailyPickId>] with inner div style.width='3%' (Math.max(3, ...) floor applied). Grid episode card same: width='3%'. Confirms both the new daily-pick progress bar AND the unrounded 3% floor for tiny listened amounts.

BUG_FIX_4_active_workout_circular_ring.details: Verified via source in ActiveWorkoutModal.tsx: `const percentComplete = Math.min(100, (elapsed/totalSeconds)*100)` (no Math.round), `strokeDashoffset = CIRCUMFERENCE * (1 - percentComplete/100)`, with `transition: 'stroke-dashoffset 1s linear'`. Ring will animate smoothly not in whole-percent steps. Live run-through of an active workout was not exercised (would require starting an explore workout timer).

critical_code_review_comments: MindfulnessPodcast.tsx: Both progress-bar divs (daily-pick and grid) share the same testid pattern podcast-progress-<id>. Because the daily pick shares an id with itself and grid cards have their own ids, there is no collision in practice, but if the daily pick were ever also rendered in the grid (e.g. relaxing the isDailyPick filter) two DOM nodes would share a data-testid. Consider prefixing (e.g. podcast-progress-daily-<id>) for robustness.
